Their research involves configuring network devices as projection points, which serve as endpoints for network tunnels. This approach enhances cyber deception capabilities, allowing enterprises to defend against advanced security threats by creating deceptive network environments.

overview_description.description: Acalvio is an AI-powered preemptive cybersecurity company focused on countering AI-driven identity and infrastructure intrusion. Its 360 Deception platform combines Dynamic Deception, evolving HoneyPaths, and cloaking of production assets within deception fabric to disrupt automated reconnaissance, credential abuse, and lateral movement across identity systems, endpoints, cloud, network, and cyber-physical environments. By altering what attackers can perceive and trust, Acalvio shifts detection from post-compromise analysis to pre-impact exposure, enabling organizations to detect, delay, disrupt, and deny malicious activity at machine speed. The company serves enterprise and government organizations determined to break automated intrusion at its source. https://www.acalvio.com/

product.name: ShadowPlex Preemptive Cybersecurity Platform
product.description: An enterprise cyber deception platform that detects, diverts, and contains threats across identity, cloud, IT, OT, networks, and endpoints.

product.name: 360 Deception
product.description: A cyber deception approach that creates uncertainty around assets, credentials, and attack paths to expose and disrupt human- and AI-assisted attacks before impact.

product.name: ShadowPlex Identity Protection
product.description: An identity threat detection and response solution that identifies credential misuse, lateral movement, and privilege escalation across enterprise identity systems.

product.name: ShadowPlex Advanced Threat Defense
product.description: A deception-based threat defense solution for detecting advanced persistent threats, stealthy lateral movement, privilege escalation, ransomware activity, and AI-driven attacks.

product.name: ShadowPlex Cloud Security
product.description: An agentless, multi-cloud deception solution that uses honeytokens and deceptive assets to detect threats targeting cloud workloads, identities, and services.

product.name: ShadowPlex Targeted Threat Intel
product.description: A threat intelligence capability that captures tools, tactics, techniques, and behaviors through controlled engagement with real adversaries.
